sourceFacts.method: Each parked row of the research queue was checked against the results of L4000 (registry against own values), L4002 (registry names), L4001 and L4005 (EA note figures) and L4004 (curves). Four soldier registry defaults named in the M1 row were re-read at raw offsets.

control.description: The soldier registry row RegenerationDelay reads 5, the base value already recorded for M1.

screen.result: EA 1.3.3.0 states M45A1 and vz. 61 are subsonic by default, matching their stored 27 / 64.29 ranges (L4001); soldier rows RegenerationDelay 5, RegenerationRate 10, SpotOnFireDuration 0.4 and DefaultSpotDuration 5 were already recorded

inference: Every parked question waits for a native consumer, a named field or a controlled in-game observation. The three methods supply none of those, because weapon rows hold the same numbers as the files and attachment effects have no registry rows.
M1 is the only row that gains evidence: an official statement for the two subsonic sidearms.
unresolved: All listed questions keep their recorded reopen conditions.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: Parked weapon, optic and soldier questions screened against the registry and EA-note methods: none is reopened; the spotting base gains an official statement
leads.summary: Parked questions W1 to W9, O1 to O3, M1 to M3 and G1 were screened against the registry and EA-note methods. None meets its reopen condition. M1 gains EA's statement that the M45A1 and vz. 61 are subsonic by default. Attachment effect files have no registry rows. 4 raw-offset checks matched.
